Enclosing class:
WidgetHost<W extends net.minecraft.client.gui.components.events.GuiEventListener & net.minecraft.client.gui.components.Renderable>
public static final class WidgetHost.Builder<W extends net.minecraft.client.gui.components.events.GuiEventListener & net.minecraft.client.gui.components.Renderable> extends AbstractPanelElement.Builder<WidgetHost<W>, WidgetHost.Builder<W>>
Builds a WidgetHost. widget and size(int, int) are required; call widget first, since it fixes the type place(WidgetHost.Placer) is typed by.
